# workflow-shape.txt — the floor under the order rule of check-workflows.
#
# A rule that reads the workflows as data reports a clean result when it reads
# NO workflows: a shallow checkout, a moved directory or a narrowed pathspec all
# look like "nothing to judge". These two numbers are what this repository has;
# fewer is exit 2, not a pass. They are regenerated by whoever adds or removes a
# workflow or a job, in the same change — the timeouts rule prints the job
# count on every run.
min_workflows 7
min_jobs 18
